title: rhaponticum scariosum subsp. heleniifolium
intro: Rhaponticum scariosum subsp. heleniifolium, commonly known as Rhapontic Rhubarb or Helenium rhubarb, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating effects. The therapeutic actions of Rhapontic Rhubarb include pain relief, anti-arthritic, and anti-inflammatory actions, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, particularly alantolactone and dihydroalantolactone. Research suggests that these bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic properties, supporting its use in treating various health conditions.
